subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should Docker-hosted Gateway sandboxes gain an explicit host-path mapping contract, or should OpenClaw continue requiring operators to configure host-path parity manually?
rationale: Both paths affect sandbox bind-source trust and Docker install setup contracts, so code cannot safely choose the permanent behavior without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Add Validated Host-Path Mapping
options.body: Add a schema-backed mapping or equivalent runtime contract, validate rewritten sources before Docker receives them, document upgrade/setup behavior, and prove a live DooD run.

options.title: Keep Host-Path Parity Only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior as-is and improve Docker docs/doctor so operators configure matching host/container paths without a new mapping surface.

options.title: Narrow To Materialized Skills First
options.body: Land only a focused materialized-skill fix through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94057 or a replacement while leaving broader workspaceAccess semantics tracked here.

recommendation.title: Add Validated Host-Path Mapping
recommendation.body: Add a schema-backed mapping or equivalent runtime contract, validate rewritten sources before Docker receives them, document upgrade/setup behavior, and prove a live DooD run.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across sandbox runtime, bind validation, browser sandbox, and workspace layout code that the decision must coordinate.
